newsitem.title: USA: General Growth Properties buys two shopping malls.
newsitem.headline: General Growth Properties buys two shopping malls.

text.p: General Growth Properties said on Monday it acquired two shopping malls from Prime Property Fund, a pooled pension account managed by Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc.
General Growth said it bought Sooner Fashion Mall, a regional shopping mall in Norman, Okla., and a 50-percent interest in Quail Springs Mall in Oklahoma City.
The acquisitions involve a total of about $52 million, including about $25 million in General Growth stock, $18 million in cash and assumption of roughly $9 million in debt, General Growth said.
The purchases bring to 49 the number of regional malls in which General Growth has acquired an ownership interest since becoming a publicly traded real estate investment trust in April 1993, it said.
General Growth Properties owns, develops and manages U.S. shopping centers. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
